question: What is the rank of India in terms of Human Development Index 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**132.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• India is ranked 132 out of 191 in the Human Development Index, 2021.
 
• According to a report released by the United Nations Development Program (UNDP), with an HDI value of 0.633, India is ranked 132 out of 191 countries in the 2021 Human Development Index.
 
• India has been placed in the medium human development category.
 
• In the 2020 report, India was 0.645 and ranked 131st among 189 countries.
 
• Sri Lanka has got 73rd rank in the Human Development Index. With this, China has been ranked 79th, Bhutan 127th, Bangladesh 129th, Nepal 143rd and Pakistan 161st.
 
• Switzerland has been ranked first in the report of the United Nations Human Development Index.
 
 
• This is followed by Norway, then Iceland, Hong Kong, and Australia in fifth place.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Human development is a measure of a nation's health, education, and average income.
 
• It has declined for two consecutive years - 2020 and 2021 - reversing five years of progress.
 
• What is the concept of human development:-
 
 
• Human development refers to the expansion of all those economic, social, cultural and political areas which are necessary for the development of human beings.
 
• Knowledge, better standard of living, equality and social justice, human security and human rights, environmental sustainability, participation in social and political life, health and longevity, etc. are all included in the characteristics of human development, thus human development is an important end of economic prosperity.
